proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I sell vintage lamps online and needed somewhere that wouldn't cook the shades. They showed me the hallway thermostat log before I signed. Two summers in, no yellowing, no musty smell.
reviews.name: Thaddeus V.

reviews.text: The size tool said 10x10 for our condo on Flagler while the kitchen and floors were redone. I doubted it. Everything fit with an aisle down the middle, exactly like the drawing.
reviews.name: Marguerite K.

reviews.text: Price on the website matched the price on the lease. Asked straight out how rent changes after move-in and got a straight answer, in writing.
reviews.name: Anselm R.

reviews.text: We keep the horse trailer here from April to December. Wide turn at the gate, easy to back in, and the code log meant I could see when my husband came by for the tack trunk.
reviews.name: Philippa D.

reviews.text: Our office keeps seven years of records in a shelved unit. They sign for the box deliveries when we're not there, which saves my assistant a drive every week.
reviews.name: Cornelius W.

reviews.text: Rented a locker for my mother's papers and photo albums in about ten minutes on my phone. Office answered when I called with a question on a Sunday morning.
reviews.name: Soledad P.

reviews.text: Good place. Hallways stay cool even in August. Only wish there were more carts by the loading door on a busy Saturday; I waited a few minutes for one.
reviews.name: Ezekiel B.

proof.guarantee: If a climate hallway log shows humidity over 55% for a day, we move you to another unit at no cost.

prices.note: 200 sq ft, a house or a car
